# BIGSHOR WIKI Child Theme

**Documented version:** 23.6.0  
**Baseline release:** BIGSHOR WIKI v34.10.0 consolidated release

## Responsibility

The child theme is the site-specific customization layer intended to run with the BIGSHOR WIKI Parent Theme.

## Current documented state

The consolidated v34.10.0 release records Child Theme version 23.6.0. A complete source-level inventory of its templates, hooks, styles, scripts and customization features has not yet been audited for this document.

Do not infer unlisted features from the version number.

## Dependencies

- BIGSHOR WIKI Parent Theme.
- Additional plugin dependencies, if any, must be confirmed from the package source and metadata.

## Update and QA checklist

1. Back up the site and database.
2. Confirm the compatible parent-theme version.
3. Preserve site-specific customizations in the child theme.
4. Test desktop, tablet and mobile layouts.
5. Test menus, templates, account-related views and responsive behavior.
6. Check PHP logs and browser-console errors.

## Verification caveat

The consolidated package passed ZIP integrity checks. No live WordPress deployment test is recorded.
